date: 2026-09-17
notes: v59 releases a COM interface function-result temp at the end of the statement that produced it instead of at routine exit. A function returning an interface whose result is never stored in a variable ("Giver.Need.o.DoWork;") used to keep the object checked out until the routine returned; now it is handed back at the semicolon, the way Delphi does it. Two commits: GOD's 55e687f581 is the mechanism, and 5c89c538b8 closes three holes measured on that build before anything shipped -- a statement nested inside another (the body of a with/if/while/case whose expression produced the temp) freed its parent's object while the parent was still using it, exit/break/continue/goto/raise leaked the temp for good, and repeat/try/finally/except/case-else bodies had kept the old lifetime. Nothing else moves: a stored interface lives as long as it always did, two results in one statement are both alive until it ends, and a condition's temp lives through its branch or loop body. VERIFIED: two new self-checking matrices, tests/test/tintfstmttemp1.pp and tintfstmttemp2.pp, 60 corners, 60/60 on this compiler at -O- and -O2 where v58 scores 35 failures and the unhardened build 31, so the harness fails in both directions; 1983-test corpus A/B against the published v58 compiler 1983 SAME 0 DIFF; self-host fixpoint stage 2 == stage 3 byte-identical; ppu-truncation-check 25/25 and unit-set-loadcheck 147/147 still. WIN64 RUNTIME VERIFIED on these exact bytes under wine64: this ppcx64.exe compiled both matrices against the v52 units and the products ran clean (32/32 and 28/28, created == destroyed), plus dist/win64-runtime-proof.sh with its own controls. wine is NOT Windows; v58 has run on real Windows (2026-09-12), this build has so far run only under wine64. Compiler-binary-only refresh on v58 -- no PPU format, RTL or package change, so UNITS ARE STILL THE v52 SET and auto-update.bat can take the ~3.5 MB bin alone; every binary in bin/ other than ppcx64.exe is byte-identical to v58 (none of the five changed compiler units is linked into ppudump, ppumove or ppufiles). The compiler reports its own build date as 2026/09/17, which is what dist/win64-runtime-proof.sh stage 1 reconciles against the date above.
